rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent for being interested in an activity, topic, or plan.

example.english: I’m very interested in learning Cantonese.
example.traditional: 我對學廣東話好有興趣。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this when “interested” specifically means curious and wanting to know more, rather than simply keen on something.

example.english: I’m interested in why they didn’t go to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou3 kei4 keoi5 dim2 gaai2 m4 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a person or group with a stake in an issue, especially an interested party.

example.english: This organization is an interested party in the acquisition deal.
example.traditional: 呢個團體喺呢單收購案入面有利害關係。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tyun4 tai2 hai2 ni1 daan1 sau1 gau3 on3 jap6 min6 jau5 lei6 hoi6 gwaan1 hai6

rows.note: Use this when the interest is self-serving or motivated by personal gain rather than curiosity.

example.english: They aren’t helping out of kindness; they’re interested in personal gain.
example.traditional: 佢幫人唔係真心，根本係有私心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bong1 jan4 m4 hai6 zan1 sam1 gan1 bun2 hai6 jau5 si1 sam1
